shared_elements: short projecting arms at the sides
incised geometric or glyph-like signs on the head/torso
justification: Both surfaces show a very similar schematic frontal human-like monolith: a blocky upper body with stub arms, paired circular chest elements, and incised geometric signs distributed over the head and torso. The main difference is that A has a clearer lower-body scheme with curved horizontal bands and a central pendant-like motif, while B is dominated by vertical incised signs and the lower arrangement is not clearly visible.
